goal: Nodes outside a bubble turn gray instantly
summary: A person's circle now wears its bubble's hue only while it is actually inside that bubble's drawn outline (drawnBubble x/y/r). Dragged out, dropped in open space, still travelling over from another bubble, away, or in no group: gray (stone). Switching to gray is instant (retarget(..., instant)); coming back in still crossfades into the hue over TONE_FADE_MS.

decisions.what: Inside = distance from the circle to the drawn bubble's center <= its eased radius; before an outline exists (first frames) keep the hue
decisions.why: Membership in data (groupId) doesn't say where the circle is; the outline is what people see. Keeping the hue when no outline exists avoids a gray flash on load.

verification.manual: In-memory demo (scratch copy of nobell/dev + this change, debug hook only there): Maya in Badminton Sunday = olive; circle moved 2.5 radii out -> stone on the next frame (from=stone, no fade); moved back -> fades back to olive within ~0.9s; leaving the group -> stone as soon as the map got the update (~200ms), no fade.
